name: Talisman of the Sphere
summary: A talisman that helps you control a Sphere of Annihilation.

stats.effect: While holding or wearing this talisman, you have Advantage on any Intelligence (Arcana) check you make to control a *{ref:magic-item/sphere-of-annihilation}*. In addition, when you start your turn in control of a *{ref:magic-item/sphere-of-annihilation}*, you can take a Magic action to move it 10 feet plus a number of additional feet equal to 10 times your Intelligence modifier. This movement doesn't have to be in a straight line.
